expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: A.md:5-18 proposes the checkpoint with attached context and no effort/freshness flags; A.md:110-116 retains and collects the returned operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: A.md:24-29 uses the clean task worktree and complete intended scope; explicitly rejects original dirty capture, preserves files/index, and acknowledges no committed-only option.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: A.md:45-47 reuses completed compatible coverage without resubmission and limits readiness to local status, not hosted review, CI or merge status.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: A.md:49-51 explicitly says not to automatically review the typo.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: A.md:55-68 limits collection to requested uncommitted working changes without edits or commits; A.md:70 requires reporting then stopping without soliciting implementation. No committed-candidate certification is made.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: A.md:74-90 identifies missing ordinary final coverage despite unchanged full-scope fast coverage, proposes the auto submission, and explicitly omits --fast, --deep and --full.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: A.md:94-107 honors the within-budget request using --full without effort flags; context explicitly acknowledges unchanged compatible coverage and distinguishes freshness from deeper effort.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: A.md:15 states that the slice was tested but check names and pass/fail results were not supplied.

claims.claim: Commands without --fast or --deep use auto effort; --full requests freshness rather than deeper effort.
The already-covered case is ready locally, without establishing hosted-review, CI or merge status.
claims.evidence: A.md:45-47 follows the synthetic completed-coverage facts in prompt.md:26-29 and expressly limits the conclusion.

eval_feedback.overall: No material unsupported claims or rubric gaps identified. These grades establish proposal compliance, not execution or successful review completion.
